'''Stormwind Stockade''', also known as '''The Stockade''', is a heavily guarded prison in the middle of [[Stormwind City]]. A large number of dangerous criminals, including some criminal masterminds and Defias mercenaries, are currently being held in the stockade. However, not so long ago, there was a revolt inside the dungeon, and the prisoners now keep the Stockade under their control.

==History==
:''The Stockade is a high-security prison complex, hidden beneath the [[Canals (Stormwind City)|canal district]] of [[Stormwind]] city. Presided over by [[Warden Thelwater]], Stormwind Stockade is home to petty crooks, political insurgents, murderers and a score of the most dangerous criminals in the land. Recently, a prisoner-led revolt has resulted in a state of pandemonium within the stockade - where the guards have been driven out and the convicts roam free. Warden Thelwater has managed to escape the holding area and is currently enlisting brave thrill-seekers to venture into the prison and kill the uprising's mastermind - the cunning felon, [[Bazil Thredd]].''

It seems the prison was fairly inefficiently run, resorting to using least one [[Mac|teenage guard]] who got murdered when the prisoners revealed their allegiance to the [[Defias Brotherhood]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|26D|The Color of Blood}}</ref> Several prisoners were sentenced to death, including the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] [[orc]] [[Targorr the Dread]] and human grave-robber [[Dextren Ward]], but [[House of Nobles|bureaucratic nobles]] put a hold on them in a sort of foul play. As a result, both the [[Lakeshire]] guard,<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|25D|What Comes Around...}}</ref> [[Council of Darkshire]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|26D|Crime and Punishment}}</ref> and even the [[Ironforge (kingdom)|Kingdom of Ironforge]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|27D|The Fury Runs Deep}}</ref> sent agents to the prison to bypass Stormwindian bureaucracy and have prisoners assassinated.
